propositions: operator-attested evidence contract currently requires attestation provenance (change id, vote, timestamp) but does not require measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege level, instrument type)
two escapes in run 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76 exploited this gap: bedrock measurements from wrong AWS account and live calls under overly broad privilege masking authorization failures

the contract must extend to declare four mandatory provenance fields alongside each operator-attested criterion: environment, principal, privilege_posture (production-equivalent/broader/narrower), and instrument (live-call/simulation/static-analysis)

a deterministic check must validate presence and non-placeholder values of all four fields; an LLM criterion must then compare declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors and flag authorization claims backed by simulation rather than live calls

the new criterion enters advisory posture and ships in a project overlay (.rebar/) rather than the shipped default set, so existing operator-attested tickets are grandfathered and no cross-client behavior changes
